source: SQL Server 2022 16.0.4305.5, nvarchar(50) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS. specials: [code point, DENSE_RANK] of every BMP c with N'ac' < N'a' + NCHAR(c) + N'c' < N'a' + NCHAR(265); ignorables: [first, last] runs of every BMP c with N'a' + NCHAR(c) + N'c' = N'ac' (U+0000 not probed), and of the supplementary code points, all of whose surrogates are; ranks: DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY v) of each corpus value; nameRanks: DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lname, fname) of each names pair. Corpus: curated hyphen, apostrophe, space and dash cases, seeded random names, then spelling classes with hyphens and apostrophes at each position: NFC and NFD letters, ligatures, fullwidth letters, superscripts, ignorables and supplementary characters. Left out: æ Æ œ Œ þ Þ å Å, which SQL Server orders after ä and ã; ß ð Ð outside the random names, whose SQL Server expansions ICU does not share; combining marks not directly after a letter (after a special, an ignorable or a space, or first), which SQL Server weighs apart from any letter; and the precomposed letters SQL Server weighs apart from their NFD (NCHAR(c) <> its decomposition, as for U+1EA1), which ICU equates.
